anchor.quote: MAYA: Did you see STONK? It's flying.

suggestions.text: Maya drops into the seat next to Leo, phone thrust in his face, breathless.
suggestions.reason: Gives the first second visible urgency, so the hook lands even with the sound off.

suggestions.text: Without looking up, Leo calmly tilts his phone toward her, half a smirk.
suggestions.reason: Shows he was already ahead of her, which sets up the twist.

suggestions.text: Quick push-in on Leo's face as he delivers it, deadpan.
suggestions.reason: The punchline is the payoff of the video, so give it a beat of weight.

suggestions.text: Maya snatches the phone and stares at it, mouth open, then slowly looks up at Leo; hold.
suggestions.reason: A held, readable reaction lets the win sink in before the cut.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on the phone in Maya's hands, fills the frame
suggestions.reason: The final shot proves he caught it early, which is the brief's message, on the real fomo screen.
